description: Prepare the active repository for CodeGraph indexing when a Codex session starts.

hooks.command:
set -e
export npm_config_cache="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA:-${PLUGIN_DATA:-${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/sinon/codegraph}}/npm-cache"
if [ "$(git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree)" = true ]; then
  if [ "$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir)" = "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)" ]; then
    exclude="$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path info/exclude)"
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$exclude")"
    if [ ! -e "$exclude" ]; then
      touch "$exclude"
    fi
    if ! grep -qxE '\.codegraph[[:space:]]*' "$exclude"; then
      printf '\n.codegraph\n' >> "$exclude"
    fi
  fi
fi
npx --yes --prefer-online @colbymchenry/codegraph init --yes >&2 && npx --yes --prefer-online @colbymchenry/codegraph index >&2
